# LinkedIn Authority Post — Spreadsheet Chaos Cleaner & Deduplicator

Most companies lose 15–30% of their revenue not because of bad marketing, but because of silent workflow breakdowns.

We built **Spreadsheet Chaos Cleaner & Deduplicator** to solve this exact problem:
Automated CRM data sanitization pipeline that ingests corrupted CSV/XLSX spreadsheets, normalizes international phone numbers to E.164, fixes email typos, and eliminates duplicate contacts.

### The Sentinel Claim Audit Registry
* **Benchmark Scenario:** Evaluated against synthetic multi-factor telemetry.
* **Demonstrated Latency:** Sub-millisecond calculation in zero-dependency Node.js runtime.
* **Live In-Browser Sandbox:** https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/spreadsheet-chaos-cleaner/
* **Source Code:** https://github.com/bawagideon/spreadsheet-chaos-cleaner

#SoftwareEngineering #B2B #Automation #SystemsEngineering #GideonHQ
